_comment_dropship_blinds: Dropship BLINDS bill to a per-province blinds customer (verified NetSuite names 'ON BLINDS ON LINE' etc., 2026-09-10). Dropship DRAPE PANELS keep the dropship_provinces (panels) customers above; DSD is drapery only. Tax always follows the province, never the product. Product is classified from the 850 vendor item number (app/products.py); Mixed/Unknown are skipped, not guessed.
_comment_discount: Vendor discount per Backward Calculator V5 (== HD Canada Invoice Allowance Spec). Booked in NetSuite as a percentage DISCOUNT item (itemType Discount) that carries the rate on the item itself; the connector emits one gross merchandise line + one discount-item line, both under the province tax code so NetSuite taxes the NET. DSD applies trade+IBx+RDC off gross and MET off the post-(trade+def+IBx) subtotal => 6.19% off gross (NetSuite item 194744, rate 6.19, verified 2026-09-09). Dropship drops freight+RDC => 5.19% (item to be created, rate 5.19). `rate` here must equal the NetSuite item's stored rate; it is used to compute the line amount (and drives the interim CSV path, which cannot recompute a percentage item).

dsd.note: Base price - (0.50% trade + 1.25% IBx + 1.00% RDC off gross) - 3.5% MET off subtotal = 6.19% off gross (Backward Calculator V5).

dropship.note: Base price - (0.50% trade + 1.25% IBx off gross) - 3.5% MET off subtotal = 5.19% off gross; drops freight + RDC (Backward Calculator V5).

_comment_ids: Internal NetSuite ids for the REST invoice connector. Read them from NetSuite with tools/netsuite_probe.py --type <recordtype> --id N (read-only). A blank value is reported by the push tool and BLOCKS a live send. Merchandise = NonInvtPart 194642 (Drapery Panels); DSD discount = Discount item 194744; dropship discount = Discount item 194745 (rate 5.19, contra-rev 49400).
